simple.meaning: רָקִיעַ (râqîyaʻ) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H7549). BibleIQ follows its 17 occurrences across Scripture.

structuredEvidence.definition: properly, an expanse , i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky

firstOccurrence.englishText: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

timeline.evidenceText: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
Day after day they pour out speech,
Over the head of the living creature there was the likeness of an expanse, like an awesome crystal to look at, stretched out over their heads above.
Under the expanse, their wings were straight, one toward the other. Each one had two which covered on this side, and each one had two which covered their bodies on that side.
There was a voice above the expanse that was over their heads. When they stood, they let down their wings.

Above the expanse that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire§ or, lapis lazuli stone. On the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man on it above.
Then I looked, and see, in the expanse that was over the head of the cherubim there appeared above them as it were a sapphire
Those who are wise will shine as the brightness of the expanse. Those who turn many to righteousness will shine as the stars forever and ever.

definitions.short: properly, an expanse , i.e. the firmament or (apparently) visible arch of the sky
definitions.full: H7549. raqia רָקִיעַ noun masculine Gen 1:6 extended surface , (solid) expanse (as if beaten out ; compare Job 37:18 ); — absolute ׳ר Ezek 1:22 +, construct ׳רְ Gen 1:14 +; — ᵐ5 στερέωμα , ᵑ9 firmamentum , compare Syriac below √above; — 1 (flat) expanse (as if of ice, compare הַקֶּרַח כְּעֵין ), as base, support (Wkl Altor. Forsch. iv. 347 ) Ezek 1:22-23 , 25 (gloss ? compare Co Toy), 1:26 (supporting ׳י 's throne). Hence (Co 1:22 ) 2 the vault of heaven , or 'firmament,' regarded by Hebrews as solid, and supporting 'waters' above it, Gen 1:6-7 , (3 t. in verse); 1:8 (called שָׁמַיַם ; all P), Psa 19:2 (|| הַשָּׁמַיַם ), הָר ׳זֹהַר Dan 12:3 ; also הַשָּׁמִיִם ׳ר Gen 1:14-15 , 17 , ר ׳עַלמְּֿנֵי ׳הַשּׁ 1:20 (all P). ** עֻזּוֺ רְקִיעַ Psa 150:1 (suffix reference to ׳י ).
